newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Century City 1996 net jumps.
newsitem.headline: Century City 1996 net jumps.

text.p: Exceptional items 681.2 gain vs nil (see note)
NOTE - Century City is a property development and investment firm. It proposed a bonus issue of one-for-four shares held.

Due to the adoption of a new accounting policy with effect from January 1, 1996, a sum of HK$238.5 million, which was accounted for as an exceptional item in 1995 and represented the net gain on deemed disposal of the group's interest in Paliburg Holdings Ltd arising from the corporate restructuring involving its merger with Paliburg International Holdings Ltd in August 1995, is now directly dealt within retained profits. Accordingly, the net profit for 1995, formerly stated as HK$545.3 million, is now restated as HK$306.8 million.

Consequently, certain other comparative figures for 1995 have also been restated. There was no cumulative effect relating to the retained profits brought forward at January 1, 1995 and 1996 as a results of this change in policy.
The exceptional items for 1996 represent the profits of HK$605.3 million and HK$75.9 million derived from disposals of certain share investments and investment properties respectively.
Total dividend for year is 9.5 HK cents (including interim dividend of 2.2 cents) vs 8.8 cents.
